body.condition: There are constants \(0<c_\psi<C_\psi<\infty\), locally uniform when \((a,b,c)\) ranges over compact exponent sets, such that \(c_\psi n^a\le\psi\le C_\psi n^a\).

novel.justification: The exponent-indexed signal scale contains weak through strong bounded-incoherence factor arrays and exposes rather than assumes the interaction between signal, cohort, and window growth.
